text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — final cutoff for v0.9.1 in ~3h. If you have version-bump PRs or changelog notes, please merge or ping now.
mike: On it. PR #428 (docs) is green and waiting for mergebot — will merge in 5.
anya: I pushed the runtime quant change but left the changelog draft in the PR. Do we want a short perf note or a detailed entry?
elaine: short perf + how to opt-in to the quant flags. Non-breaking.
santhosh: Plan for release publish: create an annotated tag `v0.9.1-rc1`, run a smoke test, then tag `v0.9.1` and publish a draft GH release with artifacts. Who's publishing?
mike: I can do the tagging and GH release publish after smoke. Quick checklist would help — don't want to miss the signed/artifact upload step.
elaine: Checklist (quick):
- ensure all merge commits present on release branch
- bump VERSION file to 0.9.1 (if not auto)
- run `./scripts/build-artifacts.sh` and verify checksums
- create annotated tag: ```git tag -a v0.9.1-rc1 -m "v0.9.1 candidate" && git push origin v0.9.1-rc1``` 
- run smoke: `./scripts/smoke-release.sh v0.9.1-rc1`
- if smoke OK, create final annotated tag and push
- create draft GH release, attach artifacts and checksums, mark release notes as draft until final confirm
- optionally enable release-bot to publish at scheduled time

mike: Nice. For annotated tag we should include the changelog snippet. I'll run:
```
git tag -a v0.9.1 -m "v0.9.1 — perf fixes + quant opt-in\n\nChangelog: - runtime quant optimizations; - minor docs updates"
git push origin v0.9.1
```
anya: CI built artifacts are ready: https://ci.internal/builds/8921 — sha256sums attached in the build page. I'll upload to GH after tags are pushed.
ci-bot: build #8921 completed — artifacts available (linux-x86_64, linux-arm64). Tests: 312 passed, 2 flaky skipped. https://ci.internal/builds/8921
santhosh: If anyone can't run the smoke, say so now. Also double-check the release branch protections (no force pushes allowed).
mike: I don't have perms to publish the final GH release (org policy). Elaine, can you click Publish when I attach artifacts? I can prep the draft.
elaine: Yep, will publish after you attach and I verify checksums. I'll be on standby.
anya: One more ask: include note about routing policy change in release notes (default burst capacity tweak). Short line is fine.
elaine: Added to changelog draft. Everyone ok with release window at +1h after final tag so SRE can monitor? :thumbsup:
mike: :thumbsup:
santhosh: :thumbsup:
ci-bot: reminding: signed artifact policy enabled — upload signed tarballs or CI will reject non-signed.
anya: I'll sign artifacts prior to upload.
elaine: Great. I'll publish the GH release once artifacts attached and checksums verified. Thanks team — ping here if you run into merge conflicts or CI failures.
mike: Will update this thread with tag push commands and links when done.
ci-bot: note: release notes template pre-filled at https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/drafts/0.9.1
mike: pushed v0.9.1-rc1 at 1763501450, smoke started.
ci-bot: smoke run #21 started for v0.9.1-rc1 — ETA ~7m.
mike: smoke passed locally, waiting on CI smoke result.
ci-bot: smoke run #21 passed. Artifacts archived at https://ci.internal/artifacts/8921
mike: pushed final tag v0.9.1 and created draft release. Attaching artifacts now.
anya: Uploaded signed tarballs and checksums.
elaine: Verified checksums. Publishing GH release now.
ci-bot: GH release v0.9.1 published — https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v0.9.1
mike: Amazing, thanks all :tada:
elaine: Closing cutoff thread — if any regression alerts come in next 2h we roll back. :eyes:
